source_issue.title: Publish to GHCR as OCI, sign with cosign, and list on Artifact Hub

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on enhancing the Plone Helm Charts by publishing them to GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) as an OCI (Open Container Initiative) image, signing them with cosign, and listing them on Artifact Hub for better visibility.

## What needs to be done
1. Push each release to `oci://ghcr.io/plone/charts`.
2. Sign releases using [cosign](https://github.com/sigstore/cosign) for security.
3. Register the charts on [Artifact Hub](https://artifacthub.io/) and update `Chart.yaml` with required annotations and an icon.

## Helpful background
Helm Charts are packages of pre-configured Kubernetes resources, and signing them with cosign helps verify their authenticity. Artifact Hub is a platform for discovering and sharing Kubernetes packages, enhancing accessibility for users. This issue currently depends on [issue #25](https://github.com/plone/helm-charts/issues/25), so check that for any related information.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the process of pushing OCI images and using cosign for signing.
2. Explore the Artifact Hub documentation for registration steps.
3. Review the existing `Chart.yaml` to understand the structure and what annotations are needed.

If you have any questions or need further clarification, feel free to reach out!
